author: Antigravity (Gemini 3.6 Flash High)
summary: Targeted refactor plan to eliminate PostgreSQL lock contention, query amplification, and 57014 statement timeouts causing gateway signal disconnections in Native35 while preserving all 99 guards, 45s deadlines, and per-frame fresh authority checks.

allowedFiles.changeDescription: Eliminate redundant liveLease re-queries in lockedLease and frame 0 of processBatch. Consume combined liveLeaseWithPolicy to reduce per-frame SQL queries from 2 to 1 while retaining full transaction isolation, lock order, and native authority.

Add minimal combined SQL field projection liveLeaseWithPolicy returning both the verified LiveLease and fresh publication permission flags in a single query with identical clock guards and subquery checks.
Remove redundant sequential N+1 room_members queries inside open transaction and move profile resolution outside the transaction to eliminate client-induced idleInTransaction delays.
Add narrow in-flight promise coalescing for reconciling groups to prevent overlapping FOR UPDATE transactions between the 1s sweep timer and incoming LiveKit webhooks.

forbiddenChanges: No modification to test files, frozen assertions, or test timeouts
No relaxation of 99 guards, API build 9, or security boundaries
No removal of fresh per-frame lease verification or publication policy checks
No movement of native authority calls outside the transaction without formal proof
No arbitrary modification of connection pool size (16/16) or statement_timeout (3000ms)
No snapshot caching or stale policy bypass
